# BioMan Biology

> > BioMan Biology is an interactive platform offering free and premium biology games, virtual labs, and educational videos aligned with AP/IB and NGSS standards for students and teachers.

BioMan Biology provides comprehensive biology education through HTML5-based interactive games and virtual labs covering molecular biology, cell biology, genetics, physiology, ecology, and evolution. The platform serves both students seeking self-paced learning and teachers looking for standards-aligned classroom resources.

## Key Topics

- Interactive Games
- Virtual Labs
- Cell Biology
- Molecular Biology
- Genetics
- Ecology
- Evolution
- Physiology
- DNA & RNA
- Photosynthesis & Respiration
- AP Biology
- NGSS Standards
- Educational Videos
- Biology Quizzes
- Teacher Resources

## Core Learning Platforms

- [BioMan Biology Homepage](https://biomanbio.com/index.html): Main portal featuring interactive games, virtual labs, and educational content for biology learners
- [Student Learning Hub](https://biomanbio.com/students.html): Student-focused learning hub with free biology games, quizzes, and interactive educational tools
- [Teacher Resources](https://biomanbio.com/teachers.html): Comprehensive teacher resources for AP/IB Biology including games, gradebook, and standards-aligned content
- [Membership Portal](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/index-member.html): Ad-free membership portal with exclusive access to games, labs, and premium learning resources

## Interactive Games & Virtual Labs

- [Cell Biology Games & Labs](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/Cellgames/Cells.html): Interactive cell biology games and virtual labs covering organelles, osmosis, and plasma membrane
- [Molecular Biology Games](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/LifeChemgames/lifechem.html): Games on DNA, RNA, protein synthesis, and biochemistry with interactive molecular simulations
- [Genetics Games & Labs](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/Genegames/genetics.html): Virtual labs covering mitosis, meiosis, inheritance patterns, and genetic principles
- [Photosynthesis & Respiration Games](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/PhotoRespgames/photoresp.html): Interactive games on photosynthesis, cellular respiration, ATP, and metabolic pathways
- [Physiology Games & Labs](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/Physiologygames/physiology.html): Interactive physiology games and labs covering body systems and human anatomy
- [Ecology Games](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/EcoGames/ecology.html): NGSS-aligned ecology games covering nutrient cycles, bioaccumulation, and ecosystem dynamics
- [Evolution Games & Labs](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/EvoClassGames/evolution.html): Interactive labs on natural selection, fossil evidence, and evolutionary principles
- [Scientific Method Games](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/SciMethodGames/scimethod.html): Virtual lab simulations for experimental design and scientific method practice

## Assessment & Learning Tools

- [Interactive Biology Quizzes](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5Quizzes/quizzes.html): HTML5-based interactive quizzes for student assessment and content review across biology topics
- [Educational Biology Videos](https://biomanbio.com/video/video-landing-page.html): Video library covering DNA, cell biology, molecular concepts, and other core biology topics
